description: This Java class 'CdyneServices' provides a service wrapper for interacting with the CDyne address lookup API. It includes a method for retrieving city and state information based on a ZIP code, parses the XML response, handles errors, and populates a response map with detailed address information.

classes.name: CdyneServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to call CDyne address services API

methods.name: cdyneReturnCityState
methods.description: Calls the CDyne web service to retrieve city and state info based on ZIP code and processes the XML response.

methods.name: cdyneReturnCityState
